points.p: 介系詞說時間、地點、方向、對象等關係：in the room、on Monday、with my friend。後面那個名詞叫介系詞的受詞。

ex.en: The patient is in Room 305.
I went shopping with my friend.

points.p: 介系詞後面的代名詞用 me、him、her、us、them：with me、for him、between us（不說 with I）。

ex.en: Can you come with me?
This is just between you and me.

mistakes.why: 介系詞後面用受格 her。

drills.q: Can you come with ___?
drills.why: 介系詞 with 後面用受格 me。

drills.q: This letter is for you and ___.
drills.why: for 後面兩個都用受格：you and me。

drills.q: The doctor talked to he about the results.
accept: The doctor talked to him about the results.
drills.why: 介系詞 to 後面用受格 him。

points.p: 一個字的介系詞：in、on、at、for、with、by、from、to。

ex.en: She works at a hospital.
I came by bus.

points.t: 複合介系詞：幾個字當一個用
points.p: because of、instead of、in front of、next to、according to、due to、in spite of，要整組一起記，不能少字。

ex.en: Because of the rain, we stayed home.
According to the doctor, I need more rest.
ex.zh: 根據醫生的說法，我需要多休息。

mistakes.bad: Because the rain, we stayed home.
mistakes.good: Because of the rain, we stayed home.
mistakes.why: because 後面接名詞要用 because of。

drills.q: I'll have tea ___ coffee.
The pharmacy is ___ the bank.
drills.why: 「在旁邊」是 next to（或 beside，不加 of）。

drills.q: According the doctor, I need more rest.
accept: According to the doctor, I need more rest.
drills.why: according to 的 to 不能少。

points.t: 修飾名詞：放在名詞後面
points.p: the woman in the white coat、a cup of tea、the key to the door，介系詞片語跟在名詞後面。

ex.en: The woman in the white coat is a doctor.
ex.zh: 穿白袍的那位女士是醫生。

ex.en: Where is the key to the door?

points.t: 修飾動詞，或放在 be 後面當補語
points.p: She works at a hospital.（說在哪裡工作）／The doctor is in a meeting.（說醫生的狀態）

ex.en: He left in a hurry.
Dr. Lin is in a meeting.

mistakes.bad: The in the white coat woman is a doctor.
mistakes.good: The woman in the white coat is a doctor.
mistakes.why: 介系詞片語放在名詞後面。

drills.q: The man ___ is my teacher.
drills.why: with glasses 戴眼鏡的，放在名詞後面。

drills.q: Dr. Lin is ___ right now.
drills.why: 在開會是 in a meeting。

drills.q: The on the table book is mine.
accept: The book on the table is mine.
drills.why: 介系詞片語放在名詞 book 後面。

points.p: at＋時刻（at 7 o'clock、at noon、at night）；on＋日期、星期（on Monday、on May 5th）；in＋月、年、季節（in July、in 2026、in summer）。

ex.en: The class starts at 8 a.m.
My birthday is on May 5th.

points.t: in the morning 和 on Monday morning
points.p: 早上、下午、晚上用 in the morning；指定哪一天的早上就用 on：on Monday morning。

ex.en: I study in the morning.
The surgery is on Monday morning.

points.p: I saw her last week.／See you next Monday.

ex.en: See you next Monday.
I go jogging every morning.

table.title: 時間的 at、on、in
head: 介系詞
用在
例子
rows: 日期、星期、特定的某一天
on Friday, on May 5th, on my birthday
in July, in 2026, in winter, in the morning

mistakes.why: 有日期用 on；只有月份才用 in。

drills.q: The class starts ___ 8 a.m.
See you ___ Friday!
She was born ___ 2005.
accept: in

points.p: for＋一段時間（多久）：for three days；since＋起點（從什麼時候開始），常配完成式：since 2020、since Monday。

ex.en: I have lived here for five years.
She has worked here since 2019.
ex.zh: 她從 2019 年就在這裡工作。

points.p: during＋事件或一段期間：during the night、during the surgery。

ex.en: The patient woke up during the night.
Please turn off your phone during the class.

points.p: until 是動作「一直持續到」：Wait here until 5.；by 是「最晚在……之前完成」：Finish it by 5.

ex.en: Please wait here until five.
Please hand in your report by Friday.

mistakes.bad: I have lived here since five years.
mistakes.good: I have lived here for five years.
mistakes.why: 一段時間用 for；since 後面接起點。

drills.q: Please hand in your report ___ Friday.
drills.why: 最晚星期五前交，用 by。

drills.q: Don't use your phone ___ the class.
She has worked here for 2019.
accept: She has worked here since 2019.

points.p: 地址或某個地點：at the bus stop、at home、at the hospital、at 25 Main Street。

ex.en: I'll wait for you at the bus stop.
She is at home today.

points.p: in the room、in Taipei、in the box；on the table、on the wall、on the second floor。

ex.en: She lives in Taipei.
My office is on the third floor.

points.p: under（下面）、behind（後面）、in front of（前面）、next to（旁邊）、between（中間）、opposite（對面）、near（附近）。

ex.en: The pharmacy is opposite the hospital.
The cat is under the bed.

mistakes.why: 城市、國家這種範圍用 in。

drills.q: The picture is ___ the wall.
My office is ___ the third floor.
I'll wait for you in the bus stop.
accept: I'll wait for you at the bus stop.
drills.why: 公車站是一個點，用 at。

points.p: to（往某處）、into（進入裡面）、out of（從裡面出來）、onto（到上面）、from（從）。

ex.en: She walked into the room.
He took the pills out of the bottle.

points.p: across（橫越）、through（穿過）、along（沿著）、past（經過）、toward(s)（朝向）、up／down（往上／往下）。

ex.en: We walked through the park.
Walk along this road for five minutes.

points.p: arrive at（小地點）／arrive in（城市、國家），不說 arrive to；get on／off the bus；get in／out of a car。

ex.en: We arrived at the hospital at nine.
Get off the bus at the next stop.

mistakes.bad: We arrived to the hospital at 9.
mistakes.good: We arrived at the hospital at 9.
mistakes.why: arrive 後面用 at 或 in，不用 to。

drills.q: She walked ___ the room and sat down on the bed.
We walked ___ the park to get to the station.
He got off from the bus at the hospital.
accept: He got off the bus at the hospital.
drills.why: 下公車是 get off the bus，不加 from。

points.p: because of、due to（因為）；suffer from（受……之苦）；shake with cold（冷得發抖）。

ex.en: The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
ex.zh: 班機因為天氣不好延誤了。

ex.en: She was shaking with cold.

points.p: come for a check-up、go out for dinner；後面是動詞時改用 to＋原形：come to see the doctor。

ex.en: She came to the clinic for a check-up.
Let's go out for dinner.

points.p: by＋交通工具或方式：by bus、by email、by hand；with＋工具：with a knife、with a pen；in＋語言：in English。

ex.en: I go to school by bus.
Cut the tape with scissors.

mistakes.bad: I go to school with bus.
mistakes.good: I go to school by bus.

drills.q: Cut the bandage ___ scissors.
She came to the clinic ___ a check-up.
drills.why: 目的後面是名詞，用 for。

drills.q: Please write your answer by English.
accept: Please write your answer in English.

points.p: the door of the room、a member of the team、one of my friends。

ex.en: She is a member of the nursing team.
One of my friends is a doctor.

points.p: a book about nursing（關於）、a girl with long hair（有）、coffee without sugar（沒有）、She looks like her mom.（像）、She works as a nurse.（身分是）

ex.en: She works as a nurse.
I drink coffee without sugar.

points.p: except：除了……以外都（不包括）：Everyone came except Tom.；besides：除了……還有（包括）：Besides Tom, Amy came too.

ex.en: Everyone came except Tom.
Besides English, she speaks Japanese.
ex.zh: 除了英文，她還會說日文。

mistakes.bad: She works like a nurse.（想說她是護理師）
mistakes.why: 說身分用 as；like 是「像」。

drills.q: Everyone passed ___ Ken. He failed.
drills.why: 肯恩不包括在內，用 except。

drills.q: I can't drink coffee ___ sugar.
Everyone came besides Lisa. She was sick.
accept: Everyone came except Lisa. She was sick.
drills.why: 麗莎沒來，不包括在內，要用 except。

points.p: between 兩個之間（或幾個分得清楚的）：between you and me；among 一群之中：among the students。

ex.en: The pharmacy is between the bank and the bakery.
ex.zh: 藥局在銀行和麵包店中間。

ex.en: She is popular among the students.
ex.zh: 她在學生之間很受歡迎。

points.p: above：在上方、高於某個標準：above 38 degrees；over：正上方、覆蓋、超過：a bridge over the river、over 100 people。

ex.en: Her temperature is above 38 degrees.
There is a bridge over the river.

points.p: below：低於某個標準：below zero；under：在正下方：under the table。

ex.en: It's below zero outside.
The shoes are under the bed.

mistakes.bad: Divide the cake among the two kids.
mistakes.good: Divide the cake between the two kids.

drills.q: The pharmacy is ___ the bank and the bakery.
Her temperature is ___ 38 degrees.
She was the youngest between the five students.
accept: She was the youngest among the five students.
She was the youngest of the five students.
drills.why: 一群人裡面用 among（或 of），不用 between。

points.t: 名詞後面的固定介系詞
points.p: reason for、cause of、solution to、answer to、interest in、increase in、effect on、damage to。

ex.en: Smoking is a major cause of lung cancer.
ex.zh: 抽菸是肺癌的主要原因。

ex.en: What's the reason for the delay?

points.p: the answer to the question、the effect on your health、an increase in cases。

ex.en: Do you know the answer to question 5?
ex.zh: 你知道第五題的答案嗎？

ex.en: Stress has a bad effect on your health.
ex.zh: 壓力對健康有不好的影響。

mistakes.bad: What is the reason of this?
mistakes.good: What is the reason for this?

drills.q: Smoking is a major cause ___ lung cancer.
Do you know the answer ___ question 5?
There was a sharp increase ___ flu cases this winter.
accept: in

points.t: 形容詞後面的固定介系詞
points.p: good at、afraid of、proud of、full of、tired of、famous for、responsible for、similar to、allergic to、worried about。

ex.en: She is proud of her son.
I'm worried about the exam.

points.t: 換一個介系詞，意思就換
points.p: good at（擅長）／good for（對……好）；angry with＋人／angry about＋事情。

ex.en: Vegetables are good for your health.
She is good at drawing blood.

drills.q: Vegetables are good ___ your health.
I'm tired ___ eating the same food every day.
This town is famous of its hot springs.
accept: This town is famous for its hot springs.

points.t: 動詞後面的固定介系詞
points.p: listen to、look at、wait for、depend on、belong to、suffer from、agree with、apply for、care for、deal with。

ex.en: Many patients suffer from back pain.
ex.zh: 很多病人有背痛的困擾。

ex.en: I'm waiting for the bus.

points.p: discuss、enter、marry、reach、contact、answer 直接接受詞：discuss the problem（不說 discuss about）。

ex.en: Let's discuss the plan.
Please contact the nurse if you feel dizzy.
ex.zh: 如果頭暈，請聯絡護理師。

mistakes.why: discuss 直接接受詞，不加 about。

drills.q: Many patients suffer ___ back pain.
This bag belongs ___ my sister.
Please contact with the nurse if you feel dizzy.
accept: Please contact the nurse if you feel dizzy.
drills.why: contact 直接接受詞，不加 with。

points.t: 介系詞後面接名詞、代名詞或 V-ing
points.p: before breakfast／with them／before eating：後面是動作時，動詞要改成 V-ing。

ex.en: Wash your hands before eating.
Thank you for helping me.

points.p: interested in learning、good at drawing、instead of waiting、after finishing、without saying、by practicing。

ex.en: She left without saying goodbye.
You can improve by practicing every day.

mistakes.why: 介系詞 for 後面的動詞要用 V-ing。

drills.q: Wash your hands before ___.
drills.why: 介系詞 before 後面用 V-ing。

drills.q: She left without ___ goodbye.
drills.why: 介系詞 without 後面用 V-ing。

drills.q: He improved his English by ___ (practice) every day.
accept: practicing
practising
drills.why: 介系詞 by 後面用 V-ing：practicing。

points.t: 不定詞的 to：後面接原形
points.p: I want to go.／She decided to study nursing.

ex.en: She decided to study nursing.
I want to go home.

points.t: 介系詞的 to：後面接名詞或 V-ing
points.p: look forward to、be used to、get used to、object to、when it comes to：I look forward to seeing you.

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you.
She is used to working night shifts.

points.p: 試著在 to 後面放一個名詞：放得進去（look forward to the trip）就是介系詞，動詞要用 V-ing。

ex.en: I look forward to the trip.
I'm getting used to the new schedule.
ex.zh: 我慢慢習慣新的班表了。

mistakes.bad: I look forward to see you.
mistakes.good: I look forward to seeing you.
mistakes.why: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面用 V-ing。

drills.q: I'm used to ___ up early.
drills.why: be used to 的 to 是介系詞，後面用 V-ing。

drills.q: She decided ___ nursing.
I'm not used to work night shifts.
accept: I'm not used to working night shifts.
drills.why: be used to 後面用 V-ing。

points.p: 問句和關係子句裡，介系詞常常留在最後：Who are you talking to?／This is the room I sleep in.

ex.en: Who are you talking to?
This is the patient I told you about.
ex.zh: 這就是我跟你說過的那位病人。

points.p: To whom are you talking?／the room in which I sleep。介系詞放前面時只能用 whom 或 which，不能用 who 或 that。

ex.en: This is the house in which I grew up.
The person to whom I spoke was very kind.
ex.zh: 跟我說話的那個人很親切。

mistakes.bad: This is the house in that I grew up.
mistakes.good: This is the house in which I grew up.
mistakes.why: 介系詞放前面時用 which，不用 that；或說 the house that I grew up in。

drills.q: Who are you waiting ___?
This is the patient ___ I told you about.
drills.why: about 已經在句尾，前面只要 whom；指人不用 which。

drills.q: The person to who I spoke was very kind.
accept: The person to whom I spoke was very kind.
drills.why: 介系詞放前面時要用 whom。

points.t: 介系詞後面一定有受詞
points.p: She ran up the stairs. 的 up 是介系詞，後面有 the stairs。

ex.en: She ran up the stairs.
The cat jumped off the table.

points.p: sit down、take off、give up、turn off：可以沒有受詞（The plane took off.）；有受詞時可以拆開（turn the light off），代名詞一定放中間：turn it off（不說 turn off it）。

ex.en: The plane took off on time.
Please turn it off.

mistakes.why: 片語動詞的受詞是代名詞時，要放在中間。

drills.q: The music is too loud. Please turn ___.
drills.why: 代名詞 it 放在 turn 和 down 中間。

drills.q: 哪一句的 up 是介系詞（後面有受詞）？___
drills.why: up 後面接受詞 the hill，是介系詞；另外兩句的 up 跟動詞組成片語動詞。

drills.q: I'll pick up you at six.
accept: I'll pick you up at six.
drills.why: 代名詞 you 放在 pick 和 up 中間。

points.p: last／next／this／every＋時間；home、abroad、upstairs；I'll call you tomorrow.／She went home.

ex.en: I'll call you tomorrow.
We met this morning.

points.p: by mistake（不小心）、on purpose（故意）、on time（準時）／in time（及時）、at first（起初）、in fact（事實上）、on duty（值班）、in charge of（負責）。

ex.en: She broke the cup on purpose.
Who is on duty tonight?

mistakes.bad: I took your umbrella with mistake.
mistakes.good: I took your umbrella by mistake.

drills.q: The train arrived ___ time, exactly at 9:00.
Who is ___ duty tonight?
She broke the cup in purpose.
accept: She broke the cup on purpose.

points.t: 介系詞後面接 wh- 子句
points.p: It depends on what you want.／We talked about where to go.

ex.en: It depends on what you want.
We talked about where to go.

points.p: wh- 子句放在介系詞後面時，不用問句語序：I'm worried about what he said.（不說 what did he say）

ex.en: I'm worried about what he said.
I'm thinking about what I should say.

points.t: 也可以接副詞或介系詞片語
points.p: from here、until recently、since then、from behind the door。

ex.en: It's not far from here.
A cat came out from under the bed.
ex.zh: 一隻貓從床底下跑出來。

mistakes.bad: It depends on what do you need.
mistakes.good: It depends on what you need.
mistakes.why: 介系詞後面的 wh- 子句用直述句語序。

drills.q: We talked about ___ to go for dinner.
drills.why: 討論要去哪裡：where to go。

drills.q: It's not far ___ here.
I'm thinking about what should I say.
accept: I'm thinking about what I should say.
drills.why: 介系詞後面的子句用直述句語序：what I should say。
